verdict.rationale: Fellow's own materials claim configurable, organization-wide retention policies, including zero-day retention, covering how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained. Its Enterprise Super Admin API lets admins delete data across the whole workspace to erase third-party data under privacy regulations, and a documented delete-note endpoint is restricted to super admins. Missing for 10: detailed docs on retention schedule configuration and auto-deletion of transcripts/recordings, an explicit recording/transcript delete endpoint and permanent-erasure guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
